checks.evidence: verify defaults: finite, peak_db -3.00, silent_edges, dc -72 dB, macros brightness/weight/busyness, rebuild all PASS; no FAIL.

time_shape.evidence: Length 0.75 s (brief 0.6-1.5). 14 onsets at 0.000-0.565 s, about 42 ms spacing (one weak, strength 0.1, at 0.299), vs the 8 or more required. Seeds 2-4 give 13 onsets each. Decay -60 dB at 0.30 s, trailing silence from 0.68 s. The 0.403 s 'attack' is only the loudest key, not a slow rise. At busyness=1 the count drops to 8, still meeting the brief.

spectrum.evidence: Centroid 5.3 kHz (start 5.9k, middle 5.5k, end 3.85k). Energy shares: 2-8k 75%, >8k 25%, under 2k about 0%. Strongest modes are 2.89/3.07/3.25/3.42 kHz and 7.97/8.45/8.86/8.98/9.40 kHz, listed as inharmonic partials (80 cents inharmonicity) and visible in the spectrogram as bright lines near 3.3k and 8-9.5k. Almost all of it falls in 3-10 kHz; the exceptions are 2.89k and a weaker 16.6-17.6 kHz cluster at -30 to -33 dB.

parts.evidence: Each of the 14 keys is a separate vertical column in the spectrogram and a separate decaying burst in the waveform, with gaps between them. The inharmonic ring lines at about 3.3k and 8-9.5k are visible across the hits. Sustained ring on 3.25 kHz (0.44 s) sits under the hit transients.

control_variation.evidence: 4 macros (brightness, weight, busyness, ring). The 3 claimed ones PASS in verify: centroid 3.9k -> 10.2k, 6.6k -> 3.9k, density 17.3 -> 24.1 events/s. ring is unclaimed. Seeds 1-4 differ: centroid middle 5.5k/6.6k/5.0k/4.2k, LUFS -17.3/-15.9/-17.7/-16.4, mode sets differ (seed 3 partials 3.05-3.73k plus 9.7-10.2k). notes: 16.6-17.6 kHz partials at about -30 dB sit outside the 3-10 kHz brief, and brightness=1 pushes the modes to 10-17 kHz.

Seed 4 lists only four inharmonic partials (3.0k, 3.6k, 8.2k, 16.2k), fewer than the other seeds.
